answer.rationale: Finance has mandated an 18% cut to component spend this year, and the low-cost vendor's quote alone meets that mandate (memory c2 confirms the low-cost vendor cut unit cost sharply last year, onboarded quickly, and kept invoicing accurate). I would lock in the price for the renewal window only — scale the switch to a small, guarded test on the primary line and monitor downstream KPIs — rather than committing a full primary move under a 94% utilization with no buffer. I would hold the second source addition (memory c3) for the next cycle once the transition has stabilized, since I have capacity for exactly one decision this cycle and adding a second source now would not by itself hit the 18% mandate. I am deliberately leaving the incumbent renewal terms (c4, c6, c1) and deferral (c5) on the table for the next review.
